page_title: RAY 0-0 CEL | Rayo Vallecano v Celta Vigo 11/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Victor Garcia has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) commits a foul and Victor Garcia immediately signals a free kick. Rayo Vallecano win a free kick.

90+4' One of the Celta Vigo players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Rayo Vallecano win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
90+1' Victor Garcia blows for a foul after Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Celta Vigo are awarded the free kick.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
88' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Carlos Dotor.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) is coming onto the pitch as Isi Palazon cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
84' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' The foul by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Victor Garcia.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ivan Balliu will be replaced by Jose Pozo (Rayo Vallecano).

82' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Stole Dimitrievski tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
78' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
73' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
72' Here comes a substitution. Anastasios Douvikas is given a rest as he is replaced by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
71' Francisco has decided to substitute Oscar Valentin and he is replaced by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano).
71' Here's the change. Raul de Tomas leaves the pitch and Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as a substitute.
70' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

70' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Vicente Guaita makes a great save to stop his effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rayo Vallecano.
68' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
68' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
65' Oscar Mingueza goes off the pitch and Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) comes on.
65' Rafael Benitez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) replacing Jonathan Bamba.
64' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
62' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
62' The linesman makes the right call and Rayo Vallecano will have a corner.
59' Good work from Rayo Vallecano as they win a corner.
59' The players claim that Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) handled the ball and it seems they are right.

58' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Celta Vigo will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
58' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) takes a long-range free kick and whips it into the box. The goalkeeper reads it well and leaps high to intercept the ball.

57' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Victor Garcia blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Rayo Vallecano.

55' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed to the bottom left corner, but it lacks power and Vicente Guaita pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
54' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
53' A player from Rayo Vallecano commits a rough challenge. Victor Garcia blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Celta Vigo will take a free kick near the side line.
52' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
52' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
51' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) sends a long ball in, but Vicente Guaita comfortably gathers the ball.
50' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the middle of the goal, but Vicente Guaita pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
49' Dangerous play by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano). Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. Celta Vigo have a free kick.
46' The manager makes a subsitution with Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) coming on for Oscar Trejo.
46' Referee Victor Garcia blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45' What a save from Vicente Guaita! Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
45' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
44' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
43' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
43' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag and Rayo Vallecano will take a corner.
41' Rayo Vallecano concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. Celta Vigo are awarded a free kick.
39' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) sends a long ball in, but Vicente Guaita comfortably gathers the ball.
39' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) makes a slide tackle, but referee Victor Garcia blows for a foul. A free kick to Rayo Vallecano.
38' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Stole Dimitrievski was alert and made a comfortable save.

37' The game is interrupted. Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
35' Victor Garcia interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano). That's a free kick to Celta Vigo.
34' The foul by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) was seen by Victor Garcia who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
33' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
31' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
30' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Garcia interrupted the game to signal a free kick. There is a free kick near the sideline to Celta Vigo.
29' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
29' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Celta Vigo will take a free kick.

28' Close! Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
27' A pass from Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Vicente Guaita and the move breaks down.
23' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

21' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
20' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) brings his opponent down. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Celta Vigo earn a free kick.
20' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
19' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.
18' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Celta Vigo comes to nothing.

17' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Stole Dimitrievski. The referee signals a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
16' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
15' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
10' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
10' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
10' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Now Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
7' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.

5' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, well to the left of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
5' The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner.

4' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
3' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
2' Victor Garcia blows his whistle after Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Rayo Vallecano get a free kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Victor Garcia.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
